name: tracethebreak

scripts.build: terser app.js -c -m -o app.min.js --comments false && cleancss -o style.min.css style.css

notes: app.js and style.css are the source files — keep editing those.
Run `npm install && npm run build` to regenerate app.min.js / style.min.css before deploying.

index.html loads the .min files in production; the mangle setting stays at its default (toplevel names are NOT renamed), which is required because many functions are called from onclick="..." attributes in index.html.
If you ever bump a CDN library version (leaflet, flatpickr, supabase-js, etc.), you must regenerate the integrity= hash in index.html for that resource, or the browser will refuse to load it.
